description: Ministry of Defence - Order to declare that the Extradition Law No. 8 of 1977 between Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the declaration of an extradition treaty between Sri Lanka and Vietnam under the Extradition Law No. 8 of 1977. It is a legal/regulatory matter involving the application of an existing law to a foreign state based on an international treaty, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
